repo_notes: DiscordRPC-Android is a standalone Discord Rich Presence (RPC) client for Android, written in Kotlin and Ktor.
Used as a Gradle module (':discordrpc') in the N-Zik app (N-Zik-Group/N-Zik, see settings.gradle.kts).
Fork of the Discord RPC implementation originally created by MetroList.
Code lives in src/main/kotlin/com/metrolist/music/discordrpc/ (package kept from the upstream fork); gateway payloads are modeled in the 'entities/' subpackage.

Key areas: gateway WebSocket connection (handshake, opcodes, heartbeat with jitter, session resume), two-phase connection setup, reconnect policy, Rich Presence (Activity) updates, artwork upload with cache + in-flight dedup.
Tests live under src/test/kotlin/com/metrolist/music/discordrpc/ and cover connection lifecycle, reconnection, heartbeats, scope handling and artwork upload.
Tone: technical library documentation for Android/Kotlin contributors.

page_notes.content: Introduction: what the library does, where it is used (N-Zik), and its relationship to the MetroList fork.
Overview of the package layout under com.metrolist.music.discordrpc and the 'entities/' payload models.
DiscordRpcConnection: two-phase connection setup, stale-session guard, and the public entry points (DiscordRpc.kt).
GatewayWebSocket.kt: identify handshake, opcode handling (OpCode, Payload, OpCodeSerializer), READY handling, and close semantics.
Heartbeat scheduling with jitter, HeartbeatResponse, Resume and ClientState for session resumption.
Scope handling and background dispatcher usage (DiscordRpcHttpScopeHandler, background dispatcher behavior).
How Activity, Assets, Metadata, Button, Timestamps and Presence entities are built and sent to Discord.
ArtworkCache.kt and ExternalAssets.kt: upload pipeline, in-flight dedup, cache caps, and the no-cache-on-failure rule.
Coverage of the test suite under src/test/kotlin/: handshake shape, heartbeat jitter, reconnect policy, max attempts, terminal/stale close, upgrade, artwork upload.
Using the library as a Gradle submodule in Android projects (':discordrpc').
